schema.name: class_members_user
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX class_members_user ON class_members(user_id)

schema.name: classes_owner
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX classes_owner ON classes(owner_id)

schema.name: evaluations_student
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX evaluations_student ON evaluations(student_id, created_at)

schema.name: growth_evaluation_unique
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX growth_evaluation_unique ON growth_events(evaluation_id) WHERE kind = 'evaluation'

schema.name: growth_events_student
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX growth_events_student ON growth_events(student_id, generation, seq)

schema.name: items_class
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX items_class ON items(class_id)

schema.name: items_class_background
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX items_class_background ON items(class_id, background_id) WHERE class_id IS NOT NULL AND background_id IS NOT NULL

schema.name: items_template_background
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX items_template_background ON items(owner_id, background_id) WHERE class_id IS NULL AND background_id IS NOT NULL

schema.name: redemption_background_owned
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX redemption_background_owned ON redemptions(student_id, background_id) WHERE undone = 0 AND background_id IS NOT NULL

schema.name: rules_class
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX rules_class ON rules(class_id)

schema.name: rules_owner
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX rules_owner ON rules(owner_id)

schema.name: settings_class_version
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settings_class_version ON settings_versions(class_id, version) WHERE class_id IS NOT NULL

schema.name: settings_template_version
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settings_template_version ON settings_versions(owner_id, version) WHERE class_id IS NULL

schema.name: students_class
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX students_class ON students(class_id)

schema.name: badges
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE badges (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, pet_id TEXT NOT NULL, earned_at INTEGER NOT NULL, level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(level BETWEEN 2 AND 8), amount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(amount BETWEEN 0 AND 100), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0, 1)), source_event TEXT, UNIQUE(student_id, generation, level))

schema.name: class_invites
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE class_invites (class_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, code_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: class_members
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE class_members (class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(class_id, user_id))

schema.name: classes
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE classes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: evaluations
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE evaluations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, points INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, undone INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, actor_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, actor_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', actor_subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', undone_by_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, undone_by_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', undone_by_subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

schema.name: growth_events
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "growth_events" (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, settings_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "settings_versions"(id), evaluation_id TEXT REFERENCES evaluations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, pet_id TEXT, initial_undone INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: items
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE items (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, cost INTEGER NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"zh":"","en":""}', category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', icon TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gift', image TEXT, image_key TEXT, image_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1 CHECK(stock >= -1), class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, background_id TEXT)

schema.name: redemptions
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE redemptions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, item_id TEXT, item_name TEXT NOT NULL, cost INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, undone INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, stock_deducted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, actor_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, actor_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', actor_subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', undone_by_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, undone_by_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', undone_by_subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', background_id TEXT)

schema.name: rules
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE rules (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, points INTEGER NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, custom INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

schema.name: sessions
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE sessions (token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: settings_versions
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "settings_versions" (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, version INTEGER NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

schema.name: students
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE students (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, student_no TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pet_id TEXT, pet_exp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, spent_badges INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, background_id TEXT, festival_background_id TEXT, festival_background_expires_at INTEGER)

schema.name: users
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL, password TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', teaching_role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
